title: THE BACKWARD DIGEST · title page
venue: private · after the print tech's misfold of Sept 30, 1999 · Box 23 onward
logline: The title page, drawn before page one: the masthead over the series' one image, with nobody in it. It letters the title, the subtitle and the tagline. The reader who reads it the usual way arrives home first.

panels.composition: A quarter-letter digest folded the wrong way lying on the drafting table, its staple showing, the title on its cover lettered mirror-reversed in the 1997 xerox capitals so it reads only in a mirror, and beneath the digest in the private washes the subtitle the right way round; a pushpin's hole in the cover's corner.

image.notes: The misfold of Sept 30, 1999, as the title. Mirror to read it.
